title: Phylax Corpora Task
description: Ground-truth task definition used by validators to score miners. Each JSON file under known_bad/, known_good/, near_miss/, adversarial/ must conform to this schema.

name.description: Human-readable task name. Unique within the corpora directory.

description.description: What this task tests. Useful for triage when miner scores anomalously.

bundle_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the skill bundle zip. Primary identifier.

bundle_url.description: URL where the bundle can be downloaded by the miner.

metadata.description: Skill metadata as it would arrive in a real submission.

expected_capabilities.description: Capability map the miner should produce — used for fine-grained scoring.

expected_policy.description: Minimal recommended_policy the miner should produce.

expected_findings.description: Optional list of finding titles/severities the miner should detect.
